description_en: Submits a media file to Intelligent Media Services for a censor job. This API automates the scanning of video, audio, or image content to detect potentially non-compliant, sensitive, or inappropriate material
description_zh: 允许用户想智能媒体服务提交一个媒体文件的审核任务，该接口支持对视频、音频或图像内容进行自动化的审核，以检测其中可能包含的违规、敏感或不适宜的内容
kebab_example: aliyun ice submit-media-censor-job --template-id S00000001-100060 --cover-images Bucket_:_example-bucket-0000_,_Location_:_oss-cn-shanghai_,_Object_:_example-0000.jpeg_,_RoleArn_:_acs:ram::1997018457688683:role/AliyunICEDefaultRole --title Hello_World --description example_description --barrages hello_world --biz-output oss://sashimi-cn-shanghai/censor/snapshot-_Count_.jpg --user-data UserDatatestid-001-0000 --notify-url mns://1253406881700000.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/queues/example-pipeline --input Type=Media Media=1b1b9cd148034739af413150fded0000 --schedule-config Priority=6 PipelineId=5246b8d12a62433ab778450740390000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitMediaCensorJob

parameters.help_en: The template ID. If this parameter is left empty, the service uses the default template for the censor job
parameters.help_zh: 统一模板ID，为空使用默认模板进行审核
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
The Object Storage Service (OSS) files for the cover images, specified as a JSON array. You can specify up to five cover images.

If specified, this parameter overrides the cover image information in the Media object
parameters.help_zh:
封面图片的OSS文件，最多支持5个封面图片，JSON数组。

如果设置，会优先使用这个字段中的封面代替Media中的封面
parameters.name: cover_images

parameters.help_en:
The video title. The maximum length is 64 bytes.

If specified, this parameter overrides the title specified in the Media object
parameters.help_zh:
视频标题，最大长度64个字节。

如果设置，会优先使用这个字段中的标题代替Media中的标题
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en:
The video description. The maximum length is 128 bytes.

If specified, this parameter overrides the description specified in the Media object
parameters.help_zh:
视频介绍，最大长度128个字节。

如果设置，会优先使用这个字段中的描述代替Media中的描述
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The video barrages (on-screen comments).

If specified, it overrides the barrages specified in the Media object
parameters.help_zh:
视频弹幕。

如果设置，会优先使用这个字段中的描述代替Media中的描述
parameters.name: barrages

parameters.help_en:
The output location for screenshots. The censor job generates screenshots and a result JSON file in the OSS location specified by this parameter.

Example format: `oss://bucket/snapshot-{Count}.jpg`, where `bucket` is the name of an OSS bucket in the same region as the project, and `{Count}` is a placeholder for the screenshot sequence number.

The detailed censor results are saved to a file named `{jobId}.output` in the same OSS folder as the value of `Output`. For information about the fields in the output file, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/609211.html
parameters.help_zh:
截图输出。审核任务会在文件输入文件对应的path下面生成审核截图和结果JSON文件。

输出格式参考：oss://bucket/snapshot-{Count}.jpg，其中，bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的oss bucket名称，{Count}为截帧图片序号替换符。

审核结果详细信息保存在Output相同OSS文件夹下，命名为{jobId}.output，output文件具体字段格式，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/609211.html
parameters.name: output

parameters.help_en: The user-defined data. The maximum length is 128 bytes
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义数据，最大长度128个字节
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en: The callback path. Both Message Service (MNS) and HTTP callbacks are supported
parameters.name: notify_url

fields.help_en:
The identifier for the input file. You can specify either an OSS URL or a media ID.
Valid OSS URL formats:

1. `oss://bucket/object`

2. `http(s)://bucket.oss-[regionId].aliyuncs.com/object`

The `bucket` must be in the same region as the project, and `object` is the path to the file
fields.help_zh:
输入文件信息，支持OSS地址和媒资ID两种。
OSS地址规则为

1、oss://bucket/object

2、http(s)://bucket.oss-[regionId].aliyuncs.com/object

其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的oss bucket名称，object为文件路径
fields.name: media

fields.help_en:
The type of the input file. Valid values:

`OSS`: an OSS URL

`Media`: a media ID
fields.help_zh:
输入文件类型：

OSS：OSS路径

Media：媒资ID
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The task priority. A higher value indicates a higher priority. Valid values range from 1 to 10
fields.help_zh: 任务优先级。数值越大优先级越高，取值范围：1~10
fields.name: priority

JobId.description_en: The ID of the video censor job. We recommend saving this ID for subsequent API calls
JobId.description_zh: 视频审核作业ID。建议您保存此ID便于后续调用其他接口时使用
